subject: Cascade security intake — scheduling & evidence plan
messages:
From: Claire Ng <claire.ng@cascade.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: securityops@cascade.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake & questionnaire — initial request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick responses so far. We reviewed Redwood's public SOC 2 summary and would like to start the SIG/CAIQ intake so our security team can complete the vendor assessment. Primary asks:

- Schedule a 30–45 min intake call next week to walk through architecture and evidence owners.
- Receive a CAIQ/SIG questionnaire export if possible (PDF or XLS).
- Guidance on sample log exports (window, format) and any available runbook for redaction.

We prefer Wed/Thu mornings PT. Can you loop in whoever will own evidence handoff?

Best,
Claire Ng
Head of Security Operations
Cascade AI

Attachments: none
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Claire Ng <claire.ng@cascade.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake & questionnaire — initial request

Hi Claire — thanks for reaching out. Happy to get this moving. Quick answers up front and a proposed plan: 

1) Intake call: Wed Jun 9 at 09:30 PT or Thu Jun 10 at 10:00 PT — please confirm which works. Meeting will include me (security intake & CS), Ben (technical lead — logs + infra), and Lauren (evidence coordination).

2) CAIQ/SIG export: attached is our current completed CAIQ export and the vendor SIG template (cascade_sig_questionnaire.pdf). If you need the raw XLS, we can upload to a shared folder post-call.

3) Log samples: Ben will outline the exact export window and redact guidance during the call; short note below on what we typically provide:
- JSON line logs (gzip) for a 24-hour window representative of normal traffic
- Controller and inference nodes separated — anonymized IDs
- Redaction: IPs and user identifiers replaced with stable hashed ids; timestamps left intact

Action plan:
- Confirm a meeting slot (Claire)
- Ben to publish a short runbook and the log-sample-instructions.txt to the Drive after the call
- Lauren to coordinate evidence upload (Drive link) and share access instructions

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Security Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

Attachments: cascade_sig_questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

Marissa — thanks, Thu Jun 10 at 10:00 PT works best for our team. We'll have two reviewers on the call (myself and our platform security engineer, Ravi). A couple of quick clarifications before we meet: 

- Do you have a short system diagram you can share in advance (network boundaries, third-party services)?
- Any preferred NDA or scoping wording we should be aware of for log samples?

We prefer the Drive link for artifacts. If you can grant editor access to securityops@cascade.ai after the call, that should be sufficient.

See you Thu.

Claire

Hi all — quick post-call follow-up and owners (note: call held Thu Jun 10, 10:00 PT):

Summary of call:
- Walked through high-level architecture and data flow: inference runtime in dedicated VPC, control plane in managed cluster, optional private connectors for on-prem customers. (Ben shared a short diagram; attached is redwood_system_architecture_v3.png)
- Reviewed CAIQ answers and clarified a few controls around key management and egress filtering.
- Discussed log sample requirements and redaction expectations.

Decisions & owners:
- Ben Carter: publish the log export runbook (log-sample-instructions.txt) and produce a 24-hr sample for Cascade by Fri Jun 12 EOD. (attachment: log-sample-instructions.txt)
- Lauren Bishop: create the Drive folder, grant editor access to securityops@cascade.ai, and upload CAIQ XLS + the architecture PNG by EOD Jun 11.
- Marissa Cole: will record a short notes email and follow up on any remaining CAIQ clarifications (answers 3.2.1, 4.1.7).

Open items:
- Claire: confirm whether your reviewers need environment-specific logs (prod vs staging) or a single representative sample.
- Cascade: review the CAIQ XLS when uploaded and flag any items that require additional writeups.

Next steps:
1) Lauren to provision Drive folder and send link (expected Jun 11) — DONE: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Csecure-shared
2) Ben to upload runbook + sample (expected Jun 12)
3) Marissa to track remaining CAIQ clarifications and close the loop (expected Jun 15)

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast coordination.
